question: After a correct scanner-matrix inverse, can additive scanner flare still create false dye-layer correlation, and does independently known flare subtraction restore the layer-domain statistic?

simulation.order: developed density -> transmittance -> scanner matrix -> additive channel flare -> flare subtraction -> scanner inverse -> density correlation

forbidden: fit flare from the simulated layer truth or confirmation residual
change flare magnitude, colour, wrong control or gates after scoring
interpret known synthetic flare as a measured scanner profile
map the result to stock truth, archival calibration, renderer defaults or product state
claim_ceiling: Controlled float64 evidence about additive scanner-flare confounding of layer-correlation inference; not a real scanner, film-stock or product calibration.
